results.title: GitHub Marketplace Pricing: Practical Guide For App Publishers | Octopus Deploy
results.snippet: GitHub Marketplace apps can offer up to ten different pricing plans to accommodate various user needs. These plans fall into three main categories: free, flat rate, and per-unit. All prices must be listed in U.S. dollars and apply on both monthly and annual terms. Only verified publishers can offer paid plans. Free plans allow developers to provide access to their apps at no cost and are commonly used to support open source projects.
